source_refs.note: iv) Thermosphere: a main subheading of 14.1 Layers of the atmosphere, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 306-306.

blocks.text: It extends from 85 km to 600 km above the earth surface. This is the region where the temperature increases as the altitude increases. The increase in the temperature is caused due to the absorption of energetic ultra-violet (UV) and X-rays. Temperature in the upper thermosphere can range from 500 °C to 2000 °C or higher.
